EmailTemplate.subject: Flywire Raises $120M! Accelerates Investment in Education & Vertical Strategy
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Flywire’s mission is to ensure that you can deliver on your customers’ most important moments without any friction caused by payments. On behalf of Flywire, I’m excited to share news today that helps us further realize this vision.
I’m proud to share that Flywire has raised an additional $120 million in funding in a Series E round led by Goldman Sachs, with participation from existing investors.
Leveraging this capital, Flywire will accelerate our investment in our key differentiators: our global payments network, industry-leading platform, and our market expertise. With this unique combination, we securely move billions of dollars across 200+ countries and 150 currencies for more than 2,000 institutions around the world. Most importantly, it fuels our ability to innovate and deliver even more value for education clients like you: the more our comprehensive receivables solution can help you digitize payments and streamline operations, the more you can focus on what you do best.
You can read more about these announcements in today’s press release <[[https://www.flywire.com/news/flywire-acquires-simplee-to-transform-healthcare-payments-experience]]>.
As Flywire enters our next phase of growth, I’d like to take a moment to thank all of you for your continued loyalty. It’s our privilege to add value to your organization by partnering with you to optimize the payment experience for students worldwide. We can’t wait for what’s next!
Best,
Sharon Butler
